summary: Views on a huge property (70k max pages, 470 regex includes, 17 views) loaded very slowly or returned 500; Manage Views failed; later view-vs-property score discrepancy questions.
mechanism: Scans API with viewId (GET /api/scans?propertyId=..&viewId=..) returns 500/timeouts because view regex filters are enormous with heavy wildcard usage on a very large property, hitting backend limits.
resolution: Some Views filter performance improvements (CS-2514); support rebuilt leaner views (Support - Sitecore/DotCMS/ASC) with simplified regex; advised splitting properties/fewer regexes.
log_signals: slow response on scans API with viewId
regex limits hit for view filter

summary: Page said it had one issue but none displayed.

summary: Login flow changed to two-step (username page, then password page); properties needed reconfiguration; afterwards list scan had pages failing as redirects to guest/login page.
mechanism: Form login could not handle the new multi-step login; then crawling/scanning guest and forgot-password pages logged the session out (and concurrent crawl+list on same user), so subsequent pages redirected to /web/public/guest and failed; a few seed URLs were stale (now query-filter URLs).
resolution: Configured multiple-interaction login (scraper.user-interaction.configuration in Retool, form login off), adjusted grouping; excluded guest/forgot-password/register paths via regex; customer replaced 14 stale seed URLs (CS-2555, CS-2576).
log_signals: login attempted on wrong pages while already logged in
gt_class_doubt: Has class 3 traits (failed pages from session logout) and class 2 (crawl found 0 URLs)
